name: 2020-2c-parcial1
title: Adventure Games: Backpack and Door refactoring
description: A point-and-click adventure engine with a Backpack that stores portable objects (with weight and game points), a PlayableCharacter and Doors with three states. The student must remove duplicated loops in Backpack accessing, replace the isKindOf: ifs in Backpack>>add: with polymorphism, redesign Door with state objects (a DoorState class is given as a starting point) and remove duplication in some tests.

design.notes: Three classic refactorings in one: index-based whileTrue: loops to inject:into:/detect-style collection protocol, isKindOf: dispatch to double dispatch on PortableObject subclasses, and a symbol-based Door state (with a key check nested inside) to State objects, all while keeping the given tests untouched.
